notes: Target ambiguity: no outcome, predictor, model, contrast, or hypothesis supplied. The replication reference suffix qXX2 is not a test locator in the original article. Candidate tests include Table 1 EU-good-thing/EU-benefit agree-versus-disagree comparisons on four outcomes; Table 2 six Cramer’s V associations (0.274, 0.091, 0.100, 0.128, 0.105, 0.262); and Table 3 Models 1 and 2, each with cosmopolitan, utilitarian, communitarian, and libertarian outcomes and multiple main/interaction effects. Example printed Table 3 candidate: Model 1 Growth, cosmopolitan coefficient 0.00306, t=4.15, ***P < 0.001. This example is not assigned to the target. No metric conversion or standardisation inferred. Table 1 supplies a 0.0001 significance level for its comparisons, not exact p values. Table 3 supplies star bounds *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001; none can be assigned to this row without a locator. Common Table 3 N=335566 is an explicit model-sample candidate only; general Level-1 N=390,373 is distinct. Neither is assigned as target N. No N derivation or group summation performed; respondent, wave, and country roles kept separate. Rendered supplied PDF pages 7–9 to confirm table layout, including landscape Table 3, and canonical-text glyph artifacts. Original statistics remain null and confidence false because test correspondence is unresolved. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders.
